items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing himself as Monk Rowe. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Putter Smith and Monk Rowe beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Putter was interviewed via Zoom on February 27, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’d like to welcome Putter Smith today. Thanks for joining me.
Thank you. Thank you very much. Thank you for asking.
